Package info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners

Class FlightControllerSimulatorListener

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners.AbstractSimulationListener
info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners.FlightControllerSimulatorListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners.SimulationComputationListener, info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners.SimulationEventListener, SimulationListener, Cloneable
public class FlightControllerSimulatorListener extends AbstractSimulationListener
Existing FC listener: virtual execution phases and an independent PWM timer.
